headline: Visa Q4 Revenue Rises 13% but Shares Dip on Outlook
summary: Visa beat quarterly earnings estimates driven by resilient consumer spending, posting 13% revenue growth, though shares dipped following its forward-looking outlook.
why: Visa is the world's largest payment card network, serving as a primary bellwether for consumer transaction volume and discretionary spending.

impacts.name: Visa Inc.
impacts.why: Cautious forward guidance triggered share declines despite solid headline revenue growth.

why_moved: Visa's shares slipped after its forward guidance disappointed investors despite a 13% quarterly revenue rise that beat analyst expectations.
